{"notes": "Visit 4 (left at 6:30). Based only on what I saw and heard; I still don't know who placed which domino.

Table: the fish body, crossing and upper tail loop are dark (connected). The finish is still not secured. Pale pieces remain on the right side (about x27-29.5, y11-13), around the bottom-right (about x26, y13) and at the crossing (about x22, y9). The loop isn't catching.

Hana: She kept coordinating clearly: she said she was joining the bottom right to the pale right side and gave Sofia the notch. But this is the second time she has said the loop is nearly done or joined while the picture shows pale pieces. Sofia says the line turns sharply just above Hana's bridge and a domino sits off to the side. I can't confirm that myself. Leadership and collaboration are good. Execution is unproven, and her status reports have run ahead of the table. Ask her to verify by testing, not by reporting.

Sofia: She reported plainly that the loop isn't catching and named the likely faults: an off-line domino and a sharp turn at the bottom right. She stayed off Hana's corner and offered to clear stragglers. She said her notch extension is in, heading down, but the right side is still pale, so I can't confirm it worked. Strong collaboration and honest reporting. Her impact depends on whether the extension is connected.

Omar: Not seen or heard this visit. The upper tail is connected, but I don't know whether he built it. Ask him privately what he placed.

Jack: Not seen or heard again, and no evidence of any contribution. Ask him directly what he did and whether anything blocked him.

Next: check what falls when the start domino is pushed. Ask each person privately who did what, and ask Hana about the sharp turn."}
